data.situation:
By evening, the room had grown quiet. Jo closed the advertising proofs and opened one last reply. A reader had cancelled subscriptions to several streaming services because the constant updates caused information overload. The same reader wanted to share a neighbour’s story, but Nora asked the team to avoid details that might infringe on others’ privacy. Regardless of how interesting the story sounded, the people involved needed to know how it would be used. Downstairs, a radio played live commentary on a boat race. Jo could hear the speaker naming each turn as it happened. The day’s work was unfinished; nonetheless, the timetable was ready. Checking the date had been pivotal. That small act would help someone arrive at an open door rather than a locked one. Jo: There is still another story to finish.
Nora: Nonetheless, the notice is ready.
Jo: I will send the confirmed timetable downstairs.
Nora: And keep the private details out of the next draft.

A reader had cancelled subscriptions to several streaming services because the constant updates caused information overload. The same reader wanted to share a neighbour’s story, but Nora asked the team to avoid details that might infringe on others’ privacy. Regardless of how interesting the story sounded, the people involved needed to know how it would be used. Downstairs, a radio played live commentary on a boat race. Jo could hear the speaker naming each turn as it happened. The day’s work was unfinished; nonetheless, the timetable was ready. Checking the date had been pivotal. readingBlocks.zh: 傍晚，编辑室渐渐安静。乔合上广告校样，打开最后一封回信。读者因不断更新造成的信息过载，已取消几个流媒体服务的订阅。他也想分享邻居的故事，诺拉请团队避免可能侵犯他人隐私的细节。不论故事听起来多有趣，当事人都需要知道它将如何使用。楼下收音机正在实况解说赛艇比赛，乔能听见解说员随着比赛报出每次转弯。当天工作尚未全部结束，尽管如此，时间表已经完成。核查日期是关键一步，它会帮助某个人走到一扇开着的门，而不是锁住的门前。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: There is still another story to finish.
Nora: Nonetheless, the notice is ready.
Jo: I will send the confirmed timetable downstairs.
Nora: And keep the private details out of the next draft.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：还有一个故事没写完。
诺拉：尽管如此，通知已准备好。
乔：我把确认的时间表送下楼。
诺拉：下一份初稿也不要放进私人细节。
